stories.title: Boccard UK’s Deeside site to build tanks for £5bn Sizewell C project
stories.summary: Sizewell C has awarded a contract to Boccard UK to manufacture stainless steel tanks at its Deeside facility. The company said the contract covers the fabrication and pre-assembly of high-integrity tanks, which will be built into reinforced concrete structures across Sizewell C’s Nuclear Island. stories.title: Chester Zoo releases 32 critically endangered newts at secret Spanish site
stories.summary: Newts bred at Chester Zoo have been released into the wild at a secret site in Catalonia as part of an international effort to save the species from extinction. stories.title: North Wales law firm rallies behind brave Flintshire toddler in £1.5m race for life
stories.summary: A North Wales law firm has launched a major fundraiser to help a 13-month-old boy battling a devastating one-in-a-million condition. Swayne Johnson has organised a charity event in aid of the £1.5 million Rupert’s Rainbow appeal for little Rupert Smith whose rare illness can trigger seizures, paralysis-like episodes and life-threatening breathing difficulties.
